emails.body:
Subject: Shipment Confirmed - PO-1000

This confirms PO-1000 (HVAC Ductwork - 24in Galvanized) has left our facility today via freight carrier. Tracking shows arrival at your site around 2026-07-26. Quantity shipped: 50 units.

Thanks,
Precision Rebar LLC

Subject: Delay Notice - PO-1001

Hi team,

Unfortunately our shop is running behind on Structural Steel Beams - W12x26 (PO-1001). Fabrication won't complete until 2026-08-06, roughly 10 days later than the original commitment. We'll expedite freight once it ships.

Regards,
Precision Rebar LLC Logistics

Subject: Shipment Confirmed - PO-1002

This confirms PO-1002 (Curtain Wall Glazing Panels) has left our facility today via freight carrier. Tracking shows arrival at your site around 2026-07-19. Quantity shipped: 100 units.

Thanks,
Coastal Glazing Systems

Subject: Partial Damage Reported - PO-1003

Site inspection flagged minor surface damage on 50 units of PO-1003 (Structural Steel Beams - W12x26) upon arrival. Replacement units for the damaged portion are being expedited, new ETA 2026-07-21.

SteelWorks Fabrication QA

Subject: Partial Damage Reported - PO-1004

Site inspection flagged minor surface damage on 100 units of PO-1004 (Structural Steel Beams - W12x26) upon arrival. Replacement units for the damaged portion are being expedited, new ETA 2026-07-31.

MetroDuct Supply Co. QA

Subject: Shipment Confirmed - PO-1005

This confirms PO-1005 (Structural Steel Beams - W12x26) has left our facility today via freight carrier. Tracking shows arrival at your site around 2026-07-29. Quantity shipped: 150 units.

Thanks,
MetroDuct Supply Co.
